content: निगमः .²1 The Veda or Vedic text; साढ्यै साढ्वा साढेति निगमे <ls>P. VI. 3. 113</ls>, <ls n="P.">VII. 2. 64</ls>; निगमकल्पतरोर्गलितं फलम् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 4</ls>; निगमशब्दो वेदवाची <ls>Sāyaṇa Bhāṣya.</ls> .²2 Any passage or word quoted from the Vedas, a Vedic sentence; तथापि च निगमो भवति (often found in <ls>Nirukta</ls>). .²3 A work auxiliary to, and explanatory of the Vedas; नित्यं शास्त्राण्यवेक्षेत निगमांश्चैव वैदिकान् <ls>Ms. 4. 19</ls> and <ls>Kull.</ls> thereon. .²4 A sacred precept, the words of a god or holy man. .²5 A root (as the source of a word). .²6 Certainty, assurance. .²7 Logic or science of ethics; सर्वे च येऽन्ये धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रा बलप्रधाना निगमप्रधानाः <ls>Mb. 5. 2. 6</ls>. .²8 Trade, traffic. .²9 A market, fair. .²10 A caravan of wandering merchants; <ls>Rām. 2. 15. 2</ls>. .²11 A road, market-road. .²12 A city. .²13 Insertion of the name of a deity into a liturgical formula. .²14 Resolution; स्वनिगममपहाय मत्प्रतिज्ञाम् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 9. 37</ls>. .²15 Precept, advice; इमं स्वनिगमं ब्रह्मन्नवेत्य मदनुष्ठितम् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 5. 39</ls>. .²16 Obtainment (प्राप्ति); पन्था मन्निगमः स्मृतः <ls>Bhāg. 11. 19. 42</ls>.
